title: fragaria aurea
intro: Fragaria aurea, commonly known as the golden strawberry, is a rare and endangered species of flowering plant in the rose family. The golden strawberry is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria aurea include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
